title: Concept: Pod address exposed in a response
description: A pod IP field in a health or status payload in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Pod addresses come and go but their ranges describe the cluster network, which is what an attacker needs to aim a lateral connection.
applicability: Deployments that render a pod IP field in a health or status payload into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Pod addresses come and go but their ranges describe the cluster network, which is what an attacker needs to aim a lateral connection.
